body.objective: Students will be able to use opinion phrases.
successCriteria: I can express opinions with 我认为 wǒ rènwéi and reasons
I can agree and disagree politely
I can use 虽然…但是… to balance ideas
body.hook: In Chinese culture, disagreeing directly can seem rude. Polite speakers often agree with part of what you said first, then add their view: 虽然…但是… suīrán... dànshì...: "Although..., but..."

vocabulary.term: 第一…第二… dì yī... dì èr...

study.title: 你同意吗？Nǐ tóngyì ma?
study.question: How do I share and challenge opinions politely in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Opinion phrases: 我认为… wǒ rènwéi (I believe), 我觉得… wǒ juéde (I think), 在我看来… zài wǒ kàn lái (in my view).
Giving reasons: 第一…第二…第三… (first, second, third); 因为…
Agreeing: 我同意你的看法。Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ. 你说得对。Nǐ shuō de duì. 很有道理。Hěn yǒu dàolǐ.
Disagreeing politely: 我不太同意。Wǒ bú tài tóngyì. (I don't quite agree.) 你说得有道理，但是… (You make sense, but...). 虽然…但是…: 虽然手机很有用，但是上课的时候不应该用。Suīrán shǒujī hěn yǒuyòng, dànshì shàngkè de shíhou bù yīnggāi yòng.
对话 Topic: 学生应该穿校服吗？Should students wear uniforms?
王小雨 Wáng Xiǎoyǔ：我认为学生应该穿校服。第一，很方便；第二，大家都一样。
马克 Mǎkè：你说得有道理，但是我不太同意。虽然校服很方便，但是学生不能表现自己。
王小雨：我明白你的意思。可是校服可以减少压力。
马克：好吧，也许可以每个星期五穿自己的衣服！
王小雨：这个主意很好，我同意！
Task: In pairs, discuss one topic (homework, phones at school, a four-day school week) using opinion, reasons, polite disagreement and a compromise.

organizer: 不同意的方法 How to disagree
discussion: Why is partial agreement important in Chinese communication?
How is polite disagreement similar or different in your culture?
study.product: Hold a three-minute discussion in Mandarin with a partner on a school topic, using at least two opinion phrases, two reasons, one 虽然…但是… sentence and a compromise.

examples.title: Opinion + reasons
examples.problem: Say "I believe homework is useful. First, we practise; second, we review."
steps: 我认为 + 第一 + 第二
examples.answer: 我认为作业很有用。第一，我们可以练习；第二，我们可以复习。

examples.title: 虽然…但是…
examples.problem: Say "Although phones are fun, they are distracting."
examples.answer: 虽然手机很好玩，但是会让人分心。

examples.title: Polite disagreement
examples.answer: 你说得有道理，但是我不太同意。

examples.title: Agreeing
examples.answer: 很有道理，我同意。Hěn yǒu dàolǐ, wǒ tóngyì.

practice.q: What does 虽然…但是… mean?

practice.a: It's convenient, or everyone is the same.
Wear your own clothes every Friday.

practice.q: How do you say "I don't quite agree"?
practice.a: 我不太同意。Wǒ bú tài tóngyì.

practice.q: Why is 不太同意 more polite than 不同意?
Why might partial agreement matter in Chinese culture?
Write a 虽然…但是… sentence about a four-day school week.
Why include a compromise in a discussion?
practice.a: It shows respect and finds common ground.
